subject: Bench SDK S8: migrate agent-memory onto the SDK (fidelity fix)
description: Refactor bench/agent-memory/ onto bench/zonoid_bench/: replace zonoid_lifecycle.py with the SDK client; replace probe_runner.py's our-way arm with the SDK's CANONICAL ON-arm (register→search→suggest_links/ceScore→wire→read) — this is the fidelity fix (adds suggest_links, stops judging-all-sessions, removes the inflation flagged earlier); use daemon.py for an embedded bench daemon + warm.py for a pre-learnt snapshot; use report.py for scoring. Keep datasets.py (bench-specific). Re-run the fixture smoke to confirm the 3-arm behavior still holds (our-way ≥ search on multi-hop; cold floor fails) under the faithful pipeline. Update the SCORECARD framing if the faithful number differs. Depends on S5+S7. Commit on the attempt branch.

summary: S8 migration complete. bench/agent-memory migrated onto SDK canonical ON-arm (arms.run_retrieve_and_answer): probe_runner.py delegates to SDK arms for all 3 arms (our-way=retrieve_and_answer, search=rag_control, cold=run_cold). zonoid_lifecycle.py is now a thin shim re-exporting SDK client. client.py gained judge_next() (GET /judge/next). arms.py run_canonical_wiring now uses judge_next->EdgeJudge->post_verdict as primary path, ceScore->overlay_edge as honest fallback when idle. STEP 3 realistic-probe smoke (smoke_realistic.py): ALL 4 assertions PASS on 3 probes. LLM EdgeJudge confirmed KEEP on realistic content (no safety-refusal): KEEP on Sarah's Vue switch note, dentist rescheduled to March 15, Alex promoted to senior engineer. Irrelevant notes (hiking, coffee survey, office renovation) pruned / absent from /task/context. keepEdge persisted in /task/context and answer used the kept context. Gold never entered ingest/retrieve/keep/answer path. Commit: f4e2e75 on orch/attempt/59fc18e1-744e-4f7a-9093-a8e12d43087b-22.
